formal: if x0 == x1 then raise ValueError("degenerate segment")
if clamp then y = min(max(y, min(y0, y1)), max(y0, y1))
model_confidence_clamp(x0, y0, x1, y1, x0) == y0 and model_confidence_clamp(x0, y0, x1, y1, x1) == y1
for all x_a, x_b in [x0, x1], if x_a <= x_b then model_confidence_clamp(x0, y0, x1, y1, x_a) <= model_confidence_clamp(x0, y0, x1, y1, x_b)
for any affine transformation f(z) = a*z + b, model_confidence_clamp(x0, f(y0), x1, f(y1), x) == f(model_confidence_clamp(x0, y0, x1, y1, x))
model_confidence_clamp(c*x0, c*y0, c*x1, c*y1, c*x) == c*model_confidence_clamp(x0, y0, x1, y1, x)
model_confidence_clamp(x0 + dx, y0 + dy, x1 + dx, y1 + dy, x + dx) == model_confidence_clamp(x0, y0, x1, y1, x) + dy

precondition: x0 != x1 and x0 <= x <= x1
formal: there exists t in [0, 1] such that y = (1-t)*y0 + t*y1 where t = (x - x0)/(x1 - x0)

precondition: clamp and x0 != x1 and min(y0, y1) <= y <= max(y0, y1)
formal: model_confidence_clamp(x0, y0, x1, y1, x) with clamp == model_confidence_clamp(x0, y0, x1, y1, x) without clamp
